note: FINDINGS-2026-08-17 item D.5: `Curator.list()` shadows the builtin, forcing `builtins.list[dict]` annotations on every subsequent method in the class. A future method that forgets the prefix gets a confusing mypy error.

decisions.question: Should Curator.list() be renamed to avoid shadowing the builtin?
decisions.commitment: Renamed to `Curator.browse()`. The old `list()` is kept as a deprecated alias that delegates to `browse()`, so existing callers keep working. All internal call sites updated.
decisions.why: Shadowing `list` inside a class that uses `list[dict]` in its own return types is a maintenance trap. `browse` is descriptive — you browse decisions by status/domain — and avoids the collision without inventing jargon.
